data.title: Ruthless Bayern target treble as Bundesliga kicks off
data.description: BERLIN - Bayern Munich have vowed to pick up where they left off last season, targeting the treble, while their outclassed Bundesliga rivals have undergone a reboot to try and cut the gap.

data.title: UEFA set to withdraw Fifa boycott threat
data.description: MONACO - Thursday’s draw for this season’s Champions League has been somewhat overshadowed by the latest developments in the dispute between UEFA and Fifa over plans to bring private financing into the World Cup, with European football’s governing body expected to drop a threatened boycott of global competitions.

data.title: Mbappe hits treble as Real Madrid thrash Real Sociedad
data.description: MADRID - Kylian Mbappe scored a brilliant hat-trick to help Real Madrid thrash Real Sociedad 4-1 in La Liga in Jose Mourinho's first home match back at the Santiago Bernabeu as the club's coach.

data.title: Angels to challenge for every trophy

data.title: Thai sports action set for TV, online blitz

data.title: Opetaia embraces the heat in Phuket

data.title: Pakistan's girls fight for their place in the boxing ring
data.description: KARACHI - Sweat trickling down her face, aspiring teenage boxer Hoorain Zahra works on a punch combination, eager to follow in the footsteps of her idol Aliya Soomro.

data.title: High quality, low risk: record number of Japanese in Premier League
data.description: TOKYO — A record number of Japanese players are in England's Premier League this season, with clubs attracted by their proven quality, value for money and the "very little risk" involved in signing them.

data.title: Golf giant Callaway apologises after ad sparks outcry
data.description: LOS ANGELES — Golf equipment giant Callaway issued an apology on Tuesday for a now-cancelled advert, which showed a male golfer shoving a female player to the ground when she reaches for his new driver.

data.title: PGA chief says 'no current plans' for LIV stars to return
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - The PGA currently has no plans to offer LIV Golf stars like Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm a pathway back from the struggling breakaway tour, chief executive officer Brian Rolapp said on Tuesday.

data.title: Kingdom in QF as pool winners

data.title: A train ride with a great who hated to fly
data.description: <p>This week I'm going back to a golfer that many readers probably won't ever have heard of. Neil Coles was a British professional golfer whom I met on a train heading from London in a southerly direction. I know who he was as I had watched him play many times live and on television. A quiet man who had the reputation of being the best fairway wood player, he won many events in his tournament career.</p>

data.title: No fear! Hudson tells Thais

data.title: Sulaka leaves Port for family reasons

data.title: Asia Cup key rehearsal for local riders

data.title: At least a quarter of NFL players ‘may get brain disease’
data.description: WASHINGTON - At least a quarter of National Football League players may end up with a degenerative brain disease, according to a new study published Tuesday that lays bare the extreme toll of America’s favourite sport.

data.title: Beaten War Elephants vow fightback in Hanoi

data.title: Uefa's Ceferin tells Infantino to go, but 'not interested' in replacing him

data.title: Nine new bosses all set for top-flight baptism of fire
data.description: <p>The most significant thing about the Premier League season, which begins this weekend, is that nine of the clubs have new managers (or head coaches) which is a record for the top flight.
